base_event_formula.activity: BTC H-second quote notional divided by median positive H-second quote notional over prior 900 completed second endpoints; require >=300 positive windows.
base_event_formula.beta: Prior 1800-second covariance(BTC,follower)/variance(BTC), requiring >=1200 finite pairs and >=100 nonzero BTC returns; clip [0.2,2.0].
base_event_formula.btc_scale: For H, sqrt(H/900 * sum squared BTC 1s returns over prior 900 seconds), requiring >=600 finite and >=60 nonzero.

discovery_evidence.used_only_to_form_hypothesis: All 32 residual-gap events >=12bp occurred on 2023-07-16; 2023-05-21 had zero. July follower trade counts were high relative to BTC.

fixed_attention_regime.economic_mechanism: The follower must be the current attention/liquidity locus rather than a dormant market; a BTC information shock can then leave a tradable residual gap while the follower is moving more and printing at least as many trades as BTC.
fixed_attention_regime.realized_volatility: Square root of the sum of squared valid 1s log returns within the prior window; require >=600 finite returns and >=60 nonzero for each asset.

information_contract.decision: Only after the full 1/2/5 second BTC and contemporaneous follower windows are complete.
information_contract.mark: Last actual trade price may be carried causally for at most 2000ms; stale state is unavailable.
information_contract.rolling_features: Every beta, BTC scale, activity baseline and attention-regime observation ends at or before the shock-start boundary. The current shock is excluded.

promotion_boundary.if_gate_fails: Retire this regime-conditioned information unit; do not tune thresholds on these dates.
promotion_boundary.if_gate_passes: Freeze a separate causal entry/exit/cost/account contract before opening any additional date or computing PnL.

purpose: Independent pre-PnL replication of a fixed follower-attention regime. No entry, exit, PnL, funding, risk, leverage, 2024+ evaluation or orders are permitted.
question: Does a fixed ex-ante high follower-attention and high relative-volatility regime make cost-sized BTCUSDT-to-SOLUSDT/XRPUSDT residual gaps repeat on unseen pre-2024 dates?

sources.integrity: Record observed SHA-256, byte size, gzip validity, schema, row count and timestamp monotonicity for every requested file.
sources.unavailable_source_rule: If any requested archive is unavailable, stop and record source failure. Do not substitute a date after reading any available archive content.
sources.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

unique_event_rule.rearm: After an accepted event, no new event in that follower/horizon family until BTC signed displacement from the event shock start is <=25% of the detected shock for ten consecutive 100ms states.
unique_event_rule.same_timestamp: Different horizons remain separate diagnostic families; no trading slot or PnL is simulated.
